# TachyonCMS docs

> Documentation for TachyonCMS v0.1.0 (pre-alpha), an open-source headless CMS written in Rust that runs as one binary beside a Postgres database. There is no admin screen yet; you work over the HTTP API or with the `tachyon` command.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/)
- [Install](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/install): from a release binary or the Docker image.
- [Concepts](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/concepts): collections, globals, documents, fields, roles and access rules.

## Content

- [Content types](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/content-types)
- [Fields](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/fields)
- [Querying](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/querying)
- [Relationships](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/relationships)
- [Joins and virtual fields](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/joins-and-virtual-fields)
- [Schema files](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/schema-files)

## Users and access

- [API keys](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/api-keys)
- [Access rules](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/access-rules)

## Reference

- [HTTP API](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/reference/http-api): [auth](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/reference/http-api/auth), [users and roles](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/reference/http-api/users-and-roles), [collections](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/reference/http-api/collections), [documents](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/reference/http-api/documents)
- [Field types](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/reference/field-types)
- [Filters](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/reference/filters)
- [Config](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/reference/config)
- [Errors](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/reference/errors)
- [CLI](https://docs.tachyoncms.com/cli): `tachyon serve`, `tachyon migrate`, `tachyon schema export|diff|apply`
